name: Cottonwood Model Portfolios -- 3rd Partner Cohort + Firm-Scoped View
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-07. Add a Cottonwood dropdown view on the Model Portfolios page (matching the existing Global/49F/Inflection pattern). Cottonwood was explicitly named as the next partner cohort when MDPF_ASSETS built the canonical Cohort taxonomy (Cohort 1=49F/SmartX, Cohort 2=Inflection/Eclipse-Orion, Cohort 0=ETF public residual) but was never built -- this project is Cohort 3. This narrows Andrew's proposed CUSIP-transaction-scan discovery method to a cheap populated-field verification rather than a fresh investigation. Structure follows the WS-C (Inflection) pattern: partner-side gold tagging (a cot-side model_portfolio_accounts-equivalent artifact) + MDPF aggregator read, not a standalone MDPF feeder. PRD docs/architecture/MDPF_COTMDL_PRD.md.
